_note: Stage 1 (地基) for real_place/build_ground.py: the land's shape, the water and the road network; nothing else is drawn. Heights: FABDEM bare-earth estimate (about 30 m samples), then flattened where the ground is levelled: pitches, building pads, platforms, roads (in that order, later wins), a light smoothing (smooth_m), then lakes. Cover: water, road_slot on the road network, ground_slot everywhere else. Slots are colour slots (core/slots.tres) and set walking cost (core/walk_costs.json).

roads._note: The network that cuts the site into blocks: every OSM way of a network kind, plus walkways of a connector kind that join it at both ends (within end_snap_m) and are at least min_length_m long. Everything else (garden paths, plazas, dead-end walkways) is stage 2. Widths by OSM kind unless the way has a width tag; roads at least flat_end_min_width_m wide end square.

buildings._note: Pads at the DEM median over the footprint; the bank round them is blend_m to blend_max_m wide, as wide as keeps it no steeper than max_bank_slope (the sun in view.tscn hatches ground facing away steeper than about 0.16); a pad with a bigger drop keeps a steep bank, a real terrace.

lakes._note: Water surface level (default: lower quartile of the DEM over the water); bank_m is the stone edge above it.

platforms_note: Levelled ground traced from the 2025 imagery on 5 m grids (real_place/view_area.py): height_m if given, else the DEM median over it. Shapes: polygon, rect, octagon, circle, with union / minus.

backdrop._note: Scenery beyond the campus to the site edge (group backdrop, not walkable): sea and land only. Sea from the Copernicus water mask, its coast refined by the imagery. Heights smoothed (gaussian smooth_m), fading in over smooth_blend_m from the campus edge so the seam matches; the land comes down to the sea over shore_m.
